summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering W3C CBD rules 1–3, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Expected test counts were derived by hand from my own fixtures, not verified by execution, and they differ from the spec's reference fixtures, which I did not have.
